definitions.explanation: The outer covering of an animal or human body.
The outer layer of fruits or vegetables.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}の{皮|かわ}を{食|た}べる。
{魚|さかな}の{皮|かわ}を{取|と}ってください。
{鳥|とり}の{皮|かわ}をカリカリに{焼|や}くとおいしい。
examples.english: Chicken skin is delicious when grilled until crispy.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}に{焼|や}けて、{背中|せなか}の{皮|かわ}が{剥|む}けてきた。
examples.english: I got sunburned and the skin on my back started peeling.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{海|うみ}で{日焼|ひや}けしすぎて、{背中|せなか}の{皮|かわ}がぼろぼろに{剥|む}けてしまった。
examples.english: I got too much sun at the beach in summer, and the skin on my back peeled badly.

examples.japanese: りんごの{皮|かわ}を{剥|む}く。
みかんの{皮|かわ}を{剥|む}いた。
{玉|たま}ねぎの{皮|かわ}を{剥|む}くと{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: My eyes water when I peel onions.

examples.japanese: じゃがいもの{皮|かわ}は{薄|うす}く{剥|む}いた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: It's better to peel potatoes thinly.

examples.japanese: このりんごは{皮|かわ}ごと{食|た}べられるので、{剥|む}かなくても{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}だ。
examples.english: You can eat this apple with the skin on, so you don't need to peel it.

examples.japanese: {皮|かわ}の{靴|くつ}を{買|か}った。
{皮|かわ}のジャケットは{高|たか}い。
この{鞄|かばん}は{本物|ほんもの}の{皮|かわ}ですか。
examples.english: Is this bag made of real leather?

examples.japanese: {皮|かわ}の{財布|さいふ}は{使|つか}うほど{味|あじ}が{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: Leather wallets develop more character the more you use them.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}にもらった{皮|かわ}の{靴|くつ}を{大切|たいせつ}にしていて、もう{十年|じゅうねん}も{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I take good care of the leather shoes I got from my father, and I've been using them for ten years now.

notes:
{皮|かわ} is a versatile word referring to outer coverings: animal/human skin, fruit peels, and leather.

COMMON VERBS:
- {皮|かわ}を{剥|む}く: to peel (fruit/vegetables)
- {皮|かわ}が{剥|む}ける: skin peels off
- {皮|かわ}を{脱|ぬ}ぐ: to shed skin (snakes)

COMPARE SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皮|かわ}: skin, peel, leather (general outer covering)
- {革|かわ}: leather (processed animal hide)
- {肌|はだ}: skin (human, focusing on texture/complexion)
- {皮膚|ひふ}: skin (medical/formal term)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {毛皮|けがわ}: fur
- {皮肉|ひにく}: irony, sarcasm
- {鳥|とり}の{皮|かわ}: chicken skin
